verdict.rationale: Probes of the standard OpenAPI and Swagger paths on docs.kushki.com all returned 404, and no evidence item mentions a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. The llms.txt index and the .md docs pages are machine-readable documentation, not an API specification, so they are adjacent features that earn no credit. A payments API could plausibly publish such a spec, so the axis applies and the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
